items.title: What you need to know about PHP2shell. Critical vulnerabilities in PHP (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619)
items.summary: Two critical PHP RCE flaws (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) are being patched. Every PHP version is affected. How to patch, a temporary mitigation, and how to check your hosts.Category: Vulnerabilities & Threats
